summary: Makeup, Hair and Nail Salons, a Beauty Parlor, and more — at My Spa Resort!
description:
My Spa Resort is a unique blend of farming, building and managing your very own resort. Harvest crops at the farms, process them at your facilities to create exciting spa products and treat your clients to create most relaxing spa resort in the world! Hire professional spa resort stuff from all over the world with different specializations to offer a wide range of treatments. Talk to your employees and clients to hear exciting mini-stories! Build your spa your own way and decorate to make it unique like no other. Have other people visit your resort, become friends with them and send each other gifts. Build, farm, and decorate to create the spa resort of your dreams.

My Spa Resort features:

● Build and customize your very own spa resort & farm with tons of different buildings and decorations ● Harvest crops and flowers from your farms ● Make exclusive and unique cosmetics ● Build different spa facilities to treat your clients ● Perform numerous exciting spa treatments ● Use your best products and enhancements to treat VIPs to get special rewards ● Trade resources with other players, add them as friends and visit their resorts ● Take care of lovely animals around your spa ● Interact with your fun resort staff and hear their stories Enjoying the game? Join our community on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/MySpaResort Have any questions? Check our support page: https://cherrypick-games.helpshift.com/a/my-spa-resort/ Got feedback? We’re always happy to hear it: support@cherrypickgames.com Privacy Policy: http://www.cherrypickgames.com/privacypolicy/ Terms of Service: http://cherrypickgames.com/termsofservices/ My Spa Resort is free to play, though some in-game items can also be purchased for real money.
